about_short_description.short_description: Triomics is a generative AI-powered platform that matches patients to clinical trials.

product.name: Triomics Oncology AI Platform
product.description: An oncology-focused AI platform that converts longitudinal EHR data into structured, cited outputs for clinical trial matching, visit preparation, registry curation, and research workflows.

product.name: PRISM
product.description: An AI clinical trial-matching and screening product that evaluates oncology patients against active studies, provides cited eligibility evidence, and continuously updates matches as patient records change.

product.name: Symphony
product.description: An AI assistant for oncology visit preparation that summarizes longitudinal records, drafts pre-charting notes, answers chart-based questions, and extracts clinical details into structured fields within the EHR.

product.name: Harmony
product.description: An AI data-curation product that converts unstructured oncology records into cited, structured data for tumor registries, quality reporting, observational research, and real-world evidence programs.

product.name: Life Sciences Clinical Development Solutions
product.description: Clinical development services for oncology sponsors that use site-deployed patient data to accelerate enrollment, measure screening funnels, assess feasibility, and improve trial protocol design.
